name: DWH Website Projection Profile
kind: website-focused projection profile over canonical DWH entities/relations

projectionConcerns.siteHierarchy: public hierarchy, parent/child relations, path declarations and ordering
projectionConcerns.content: content identity/declaration and content placement/binding relations
projectionConcerns.projectors: projector identity, declarative configuration, variant relations and placement
projectionConcerns.rendererBindings: binding from projected presentation identity to executable renderer identity/path
projectionConcerns.routes: public route declarations and route-to-page/resource relations
projectionConcerns.composition: page/section graph, ordering and placement relations
projectionConcerns.actions: action presentation identity/metadata, domain action reference and placement relations

authorityRule: website projection concerns are views/bindings over canonical DWH truth; this profile does not create a parallel website-specific semantic authority
projectionRule: WebEngine receives deterministic projections and does not become canonical authority
relationRules: relation identity is defined by a canonical contract rather than inferred from field names or physical layout
ordering is declarative relation/projection data and does not change entity identity
a missing required relation fails visibly rather than invoking heuristic fallback
runtime state created by WebEngine, WebGUI or S3D does not mutate canonical authority unless an explicit governed write path is invoked
website labels, routes and file paths do not establish MetaModule identity
recursive nanoCMS Page structure replaces separate Site/Section/Menu/Navigation/Tree authorities
